entities.name: Affonso Évora
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Affonso de Azevedo Évora, also commonly known as Fon-Fon, was a Brazilian basketball player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics. There he won the bronze medal with the national team under the guidance of head coach Moacyr Daiuto.
